title: Bag End to Mount Doom
subtitle: Frodo's walk, about 1,800 miles
sourceNote: Tolkien never published distances. These are derived from fan cartography of his maps, chiefly Karen Wynn Fonstad's Atlas of Middle-earth, and should be treated as roughly right rather than exact.

waypoints.name: Bucklebury Ferry
waypoints.body: Out of the Shire, with a Black Rider on the far bank. Barely two percent of the way and already being hunted.

waypoints.name: Bree
waypoints.body: The Prancing Pony, and a ranger in the corner who turns out to be a king. The first strangers Frodo has ever really met.

waypoints.name: Weathertop
waypoints.body: Where Frodo is stabbed with a Morgul blade. He never fully recovers from this, and it is barely a tenth of the journey.

waypoints.name: Rivendell
waypoints.body: The last homely house. The Council meets, the Fellowship forms, and the Ring goes south instead of staying safe.

waypoints.name: The Gates of Moria
waypoints.body: Caradhras beat them, so they go under the mountain instead. Speak friend and enter.

waypoints.name: Lothlorien
waypoints.body: Out the far side without Gandalf. Time runs strangely here, and they leave with boats, cloaks and lembas.

waypoints.name: Amon Hen
waypoints.body: The Fellowship breaks. Boromir falls, and Frodo and Sam go on alone — a bit under forty percent of the way.

waypoints.name: The Emyn Muil
waypoints.body: Days lost in a maze of sharp rock, going in circles, until Gollum finally catches up with them.

waypoints.name: The Dead Marshes
waypoints.body: Faces in the water from a battle three thousand years old. Do not follow the lights.

waypoints.name: The Black Gate
waypoints.body: Halfway, and the front door is shut. They turn south to look for another way in.

waypoints.name: Ithilien
waypoints.body: A green country still, and the last pleasant place either of them will see. Faramir lets them go.

waypoints.name: Cirith Ungol
waypoints.body: The stairs, the spider, and Sam carrying both the Ring and Frodo. Two thirds of the way, and the worst of it is still ahead.

waypoints.name: The Plateau of Gorgoroth
waypoints.body: Ash, thirst, and orc patrols. This last stretch is short on the map and nearly kills them both.

waypoints.name: Mount Doom
waypoints.body: The end. Frodo does not manage to throw it in — and that, arguably, is the whole point of the book.
